messages:
Priya (Product): Quick sync — we need to pick a routing/tenant strategy to ship in the next sprint. Customer asks are stacking up (FinCo wants strict isolation; several startups prefer cost-efficient multiplexing). I want a clear tradeoff we can commit to for the Q3 launch.

Rory (Architect): Two practical paths: 1) Phase A = soft-affinity (best-effort slices + fallbacks), 2) Phase B = opt-in hard isolation (pinned slices). Soft-affinity reduces wasted capacity but increases blast radius.

Samir (SRE): If we go soft-affinity we must define eviction/fallback behavior and telemetry. Minimal controls: evict_threshold=0.8, backpressure_window=30s, and automatic fallback to regional spare pool. Otherwise ops load skyrockets.

Ava (PM): FinCo is explicit: "no noisy neighbors" requirement for production. They will pay for pinned capacity. We should allow per-customer pinning in Phase A as a paid opt-in, not a global constraint.

Priya (Product): Proposal: Ship soft-affinity by default with per-tenant pinning as a paid feature. Launch criteria: (a) documented rollback path, (b) automated eviction rules + metrics, (c) customer migration playbook. Need agreement by EOD tomorrow.

Rory (Architect): Implementation notes: routing policy will have 3 buckets: P1 pinned, P2 soft-affinity with KV cache tagging, P3 overflow. We'll need router changes to prefer P1 then P2 then P3. Example policy snippet: ```route.prefer = ["pinned", "soft-affinity", "overflow"]```

Samir (SRE): Metrics to ship: per-tenant q95 latency, tenant_cpu_share, evictions/sec, fallback_rate. Alerting: fallback_rate > 1% sustained for 5m -> page. Also add a synthetic test hitting tenant hot paths to detect regressions.

Ava (PM): Canary plan: target 10 pilot tenants (mix of FinCo-like and shared), measure cost delta and latency delta for 2 weeks. If pinned opt-ins show predictable SLAs and ops overhead is low, widen rollout.

Priya (Product): Risks called out: migration complexity for existing Dedicated customers, billing edge cases for partial pinning, and cross-region affinity mismatch. Need owners: Rory for policy impl, Samir for ops/runbook/alerts, Ava for pilot coordination.

Rory (Architect): I'll open the RFC with these params and a short design doc. Expect PR by tomorrow afternoon.

Samir (SRE): I'll draft the runbook + alert thresholds. Quick question: do we want hard eviction (kill) or soft drain first? My vote: soft drain, then hard evict after configurable grace (default 60s).

Ava (PM): soft drain -> hard evict after 60s seems reasonable. Add customer-visible status so pinned tenants see when fallbacks happen.

Priya (Product): Great. Action items: Rory RFC, Samir runbook, Ava pilot list + billing updates. @deploy-bot please post RFC link when ready. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: RFC posted: https://redwood.internal/rfc/guardrails-routing-1745678901 — please review and add comments by EOD tomorrow.
